cases.case: Icon-only add-to-basket control without a name
cases.required: Actual browser name/role and button-name measurement

cases.case: Review dialog opens while actual keyboard focus remains outside
cases.required: Real key action, before/after focus and captured dialog

cases.case: Triggered form error gives no useful recovery instruction
cases.required: Deliberately triggered error and exact visible content

cases.case: Task-relevant text has insufficient measured contrast
cases.required: Measured colours, size and relevant contrast rule

cases.case: A required selection is lost on the tested return step
cases.required: Same recorded selection before and after a real return action

cases.case: Meaningful image has no suitable text alternative
cases.required: Image purpose, browser-exposed alternative and task context
Real accessible name and actual activation

cases.case: Dialog moves focus inside and returns it after closing
cases.required: Actual keyboard open/close and focus evidence

cases.case: Price changes because the robot changes quantity
cases.required: Original quantity action and comparable totals

cases.case: Intentional restrained visual style is internally clear
cases.required: Original image and contextual expert review, without invented brand rules
